title: Add a light and a camera

steps.spoken: Open the Add menu. Lights live there too.
steps.why: Everything in a scene, even a light, is an object you add.
steps.hint_if_stuck: The Add menu is in the bar above the 3D view.

steps.spoken: Choose Light to see the kinds of light.
steps.why: Point lights glow in every direction, like a bulb. Sun lights shine in parallel, like daylight.
steps.docs_query: light types point sun spot area
steps.hint_if_stuck: Light is near the middle of the Add menu, with an arrow on its right.

steps.spoken: Choose Point. A new light appears in your scene.
steps.why: More lights mean more control over how the scene looks.
steps.hint_if_stuck: Point is the first item in the Light list.

steps.spoken: Open the Add menu again. This time we add a camera.
steps.why: The camera decides what your final picture shows.
steps.hint_if_stuck: The Add menu is in the bar above the 3D view.

steps.spoken: Choose Camera. You now have a second camera in the scene.
steps.why: A scene can hold many cameras, but only one is active at a time.
steps.hint_if_stuck: Camera is in the middle of the Add menu, below Light Probe.
